Summing ranks yields [n choose k]_q∏_(i=0)^(n-k-1)(q^(2k)-q^i), nonzero iff k≥ceil(n/3); polynomial leading degree 3floor(n²/4) and parity-dependent coefficient follow by maximizing 3k(n−k). Independently enumerated actual square-zero matrices and rank/kernel strata at (n,q)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,2): total ordered pairs 10,33,148 with 4,4,5 strata respectively. Proof establishes all finite fields; tests do not.
